answer: A stake-weighted reputation atlas resists sybils: each agent must lock a refundable onyx bond before joining, and the bond is slashed if peers attest to duplicate identities. Reputation then grows on a terrace of verified work — small tasks first, bigger ones only after consistent honest attestations — so spinning up many fake agents costs more in locked bonds and lost time than any one fake identity can earn. Attackers pay per identity; honest agents pay once.
